# Zephaniah

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Zephaniah proclaims the coming Day of the Lord while promising restoration for the faithful remnant. The book teaches that judgment and hope coexist in God's redemptive plan.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Zephaniah 1:12</div>

<div class="identifier">I will search Jerusalem with lamps</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces the coming Day of the Lord and judgment upon Judah's sin. The key verse emphasizes that complacency and spiritual indifference will not escape God's scrutiny.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Zephaniah 2:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Seek ye the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls for repentance and warns surrounding nations of coming judgment. The key verse encourages humility and seeking the Lord before judgment falls.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Zephaniah 3:17</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most beloved prophetic promises

### Chapter Insight

This chapter moves from judgment to restoration and joy. The key verse reveals God's delight in redeeming and rejoicing over His restored people.
:::
